mapper.select: SELECT p.BID_CASE_ID, p.INSTITUTION_ID, p.STATE_CD, p.CONFIRMED_BY, p.CONFIRMED_AT, p.OPEN_REQ_ID, p.PLAN_REQ_ID, p.OPENED_BY, p.OPENED_AT, p.WRITE_BY, p.WRITE_AT, p.UPDATED_BY, p.UPDATED_AT, i.NAME_KO AS INSTITUTION_NAME, c.CODE_NAME AS STATE_NAME FROM BID_PREP p LEFT JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.INSTITUTION_ID = p.INSTITUTION_ID LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE c ON c.CODE_GROUP = 'PREP_STATE' AND c.CODE = p.STATE_CD ORDER BY p.CONFIRMED_AT DESC, p.BID_CASE_ID
SELECT INSTITUTION_ID FROM INSTITUTIONS WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BID_PREP (BID_CASE_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, STATE_CD, CONFIRMED_BY, CONFIRMED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{institutionId}, #{stateCd}, #{by}, #{now}, #{by}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE BID_PREP SET STATE_CD = #{toState}, UPDATED_BY = #{by}, UPDATED_AT = #{now} WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND STATE_CD = #{fromState}
UPDATE BID_PREP SET STATE_CD = 'CONFIRMED', UPDATED_BY = #{by}, UPDATED_AT = #{now} WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND STATE_CD = 'OPEN_PENDING' AND OPEN_REQ_ID = #{reqId}
UPDATE BID_PREP SET STATE_CD = 'WRITABLE', UPDATED_BY = #{by}, UPDATED_AT = #{now} WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND STATE_CD = 'APPROVAL_PENDING' AND PLAN_REQ_ID = #{reqId}
UPDATE BID_PREP SET STATE_CD = 'IN_PROGRESS', UPDATED_BY = #{by}, UPDATED_AT = #{now} WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND STATE_CD = 'APPROVAL_PENDING' AND PLAN_REQ_ID = #{reqId}
mapper.select: SELECT BID_CASE_ID FROM BID_PREP WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND STATE_CD = 'CANCELLED' AND OPENED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC, BID_CASE_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BID_ASSIGNMENT WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo}
SELECT RESULT_CD FROM BOARD_MATERIAL WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID DESC

SELECT t.BID_CASE_ID, t.TASK_CD, t.SORT_NO, t.KIND_CD, t.JUDGE_CD, t.FACT_KEY, t.PRECOND_KEY, t.PREREQ_CD, t.COND_KEY, t.DONE_YN, t.DONE_BY, t.DONE_AT, t.REF_ATTACH_ID, t.REF_SHA256, t.REF_BY, t.REF_AT, d.TASK_NAME AS TASK_NAME, COALESCE(d.READY_YN, 1) AS READY_YN FROM BID_PREP_TASK t LEFT JOIN PREP_TASK_DEF d ON d.TASK_CD = t.TASK_CD WHERE t.BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} ORDER BY t.SORT_NO, t.TASK_CD
SELECT TASK_CD, SORT_NO, KIND_CD, JUDGE_CD, FACT_KEY, PRECOND_KEY, PREREQ_CD, COND_KEY, 0 AS DONE_YN FROM PREP_TASK_DEF WHERE ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY SORT_NO, TASK_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BID_PREP_TASK (BID_CASE_ID, TASK_CD, SORT_NO, KIND_CD, JUDGE_CD, FACT_KEY, PRECOND_KEY, PREREQ_CD, COND_KEY, DONE_YN) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{t.taskCd}, #{t.sortNo}, #{t.kindCd}, #{t.judgeCd}, #{t.factKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{t.precondKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{t.prereqCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{t.condKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE BID_PREP_TASK SET DONE_YN = #{done}, DONE_BY = #{by,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DONE_AT = #{now} WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND TASK_CD = #{taskCd} AND DONE_YN = #{expect}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_MATERIAL WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT RFP_PATH FROM INSTITUTIONS WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId}
SELECT i.NAME_KO FROM BID_CASES b JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.INSTITUTION_ID = b.INSTITUTION_ID WHERE b.BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BID_PREP_LOG (BID_CASE_ID, EVENT_CD, FROM_STATE, TO_STATE, TASK_CD, REQ_ID, REASON, ACTOR_EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, LOGGED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{eventCd}, #{fromState,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toState,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taskCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actorEmpNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{verified}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT l.EVENT_CD, c.CODE_NAME AS EVENT_NAME, l.FROM_STATE, l.TO_STATE, l.TASK_CD, l.REQ_ID, l.REASON, l.ACTOR_EMP_NO, u.NAME AS ACTOR_NAME, l.EMP_VERIFIED, l.LOGGED_AT FROM BID_PREP_LOG l LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE c ON c.CODE_GROUP = 'PREP_EVENT' AND c.CODE = l.EVENT_CD LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.EMP_NO = l.ACTOR_EMP_NO WHERE l.BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} ORDER BY l.LOG_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BID_PREP_ACT (BID_CASE_ID, ACTION_CD, OUTCOME, STATE_CD, TASK_CD, ATTACH_ID, ACTOR_EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, SCREEN_ID, BUTTON_ID, UI_VALID, LOGGED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{actionCd}, #{outcome}, #{stateCd}, #{taskCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{attachId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{actorEmpNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{verified}, #{screenId}, #{buttonId}, #{uiValid}, #{now})

INSERT INTO BID_PREP_LOG (BID_CASE_ID, EVENT_CD, FROM_STATE, TO_STATE, TASK_CD, ATTACH_ID, FROM_ATTACH_ID, REASON, ACTOR_EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, LOGGED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{eventCd}, #{fromState,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toState,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taskCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{attachId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{fromAttachId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actorEmpNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{verified}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT STATE_CD FROM BID_PREP WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ATTACH_ID, BID_CASE_ID, TASK_CD, ORIG_NAME, EXT_CD, SIZE_BYTES, SHA256, STORE_KEY, PII_STATE, PII_NOTE, VALID_YN, UPLOADED_BY, UPLOADED_AT, UPLOADED_VERIFIED, VOIDED_BY, VOIDED_AT FROM BID_PREP_ATTACH WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} ORDER BY ATTACH_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BID_PREP_ATTACH WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(SIZE_BYTES), 0) FROM BID_PREP_ATTACH WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BID_PREP_ATTACH WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND TASK_CD = #{taskCd} AND VALID_YN = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BID_PREP_TASK WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND REF_ATTACH_ID = #{attachId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BID_PREP_ATTACH (BID_CASE_ID, TASK_CD, ORIG_NAME, EXT_CD, SIZE_BYTES, SHA256, STORE_KEY, PII_STATE, PII_NOTE, VALID_YN, UPLOADED_BY, UPLOADED_AT, UPLOADED_VERIFIED) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{taskCd}, #{origName}, #{extCd}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{storeKey}, #{piiState}, #{piiNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, #{uploadedBy}, #{uploadedAt}, #{uploadedVerified})
mapper.update: UPDATE BID_PREP_ATTACH SET VALID_YN = 0, VOIDED_BY = #{by}, VOIDED_AT = #{now} WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND ATTACH_ID = #{attachId} AND VALID_YN = 1
UPDATE BID_PREP_TASK SET REF_ATTACH_ID = #{attachId}, REF_SHA256 = #{sha256}, REF_BY = #{by}, REF_AT = #{now} WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND TASK_CD = #{taskCd}
UPDATE BID_PREP_TASK SET REF_ATTACH_ID = NULL, REF_SHA256 = NULL, REF_BY = NULL, REF_AT = NULL WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND TASK_CD = #{taskCd} AND REF_ATTACH_ID IS NOT NULL
